canvas.help: Drag the board to move it, the wheel to zoom. Drag from a port onto a node to connect. Tab to a node, Enter to open it, arrows to move it, Delete to remove it. N adds a node, Shift+S a note, Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V copy and paste, Ctrl+Z undoes, 1 fits the view.
canvas.helpReadOnly: Drag the board to move it, the wheel or two fingers to zoom. Tab to a node and press Enter to see it.
canvas.listUnavailable: This graph has joins the list cannot draw, so it opens on the canvas.
canvas.phoneReadOnly: On a phone the canvas is for looking. Edit in the list view.
canvas.paletteHint: Type to search, Enter adds the first match.
canvas.alwaysHint: Drag from the dot on the left to a step to run it after every run.
canvas.dragToConnect: Drag to a node to connect
canvas.noOutput: Run a test to see what this node gives.
canvas.pinTooLarge: Too large to pin (64 KB at most).
canvas.pinHint: Test runs use a pinned sample instead of running the node. Live runs never do.
canvas.noReferences: No earlier step gives values yet.
canvas.testHint: Runs the saved draft. Pinned nodes use their sample; the others really run.

refusals.self: A node cannot lead into itself.
refusals.crossesLane: The main flow and the Always lane stay apart.
refusals.intoLaneStart: The Always lane starts on its own.
refusals.laneTaken: The Always lane already has a start.

canvas.alwaysLeave: Take out of the Always lane
